You order an Air2Growth machine, and our: This tour shows the intended journey: our team delivers and installs an Air2Growth system on your farm and shows you how to use it. The system captures CO₂ from the surrounding air for microalgae cultivation. With water, nutrients and light, the algae grow. The algae are then harvested and processed into liquid fertiliser.
You can check operating status, producti: The integrated touchscreen is intended to show operating status, production, tank levels and energy use. Connected monitoring would share machine status and fault information with Air2Growth, so our team could investigate problems and keep you updated during maintenance. This monitoring covers operational data and fault codes; it does not collect other private information from your site.
